title: WorkPulse leave.approved v1
description: A pending leave request was approved. The only leave transition that reaches the live wall (realtime consumer → `on_leave`). Identifiers, type code, dates and actor only — the reason and decision note are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

leave_type_code.description: Seeded leave type code; `annual`/`sick` deducted the balance on approval.

start_date.description: First day of the leave range (inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

end_date.description: Last day of the leave range (inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

days.description: Whole inclusive calendar days in the range; `annual`/`sick` deducted this many days from the balance, `unpaid` deducted nothing.

decided_by.description: Actor user id that approved the request (ADR 0010 — never the requester).
